resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Washington Division of Forestry/DNR; firelookout.com says Washington State Division of Forestry and Rex's page says State Division of Forestry. The names differ slightly and are treated as the same state forestry agency.

sources.title: Black Rock Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: Only four sources, and two of them (firelookout.com and Rex's page) repeat the register's record. A web search for a 1923 Black Rock lookout in Whatcom County returned nothing matching, so the site, its name, and its later history rest on the register alone. The destroyed date is unknown. No source describes what remains today or whether the site is open to visitors. The brief's record matches: county, agency, registration date and FFLOS number all check out; no corrections proposed.
